gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve all issue type schemes available in the Jira Cloud platform to understand how issues are categorized across different projects.
gold.ideal: The response should include a list of all issue type schemes with their respective IDs and names.

gold.user: As a Jira administrator, I want to create a new issue type scheme to better organize the types of issues for my team's projects.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the creation of the issue type scheme and return its ID and details.

gold.user: As a developer, I need to get the mapping of issue type schemes to projects to ensure that the correct issue types are available for each project.
gold.ideal: The response should provide a mapping of issue type schemes to their associated projects.

gold.user: As a project lead, I want to find out which issue type scheme is assigned to my project to ensure we are using the correct issue types.
gold.ideal: The response should return the issue type scheme currently assigned to the specified project.

gold.user: As a project administrator, I want to assign a specific issue type scheme to my project to align it with our workflow.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the assignment of the issue type scheme to the project.

gold.user: As a Jira administrator, I need to delete an obsolete issue type scheme to keep our configuration clean and manageable.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the deletion of the specified issue type scheme.

gold.user: As a project manager, I want to update an existing issue type scheme to reflect changes in our project requirements.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the update and return the updated details of the issue type scheme.

gold.user: As a project administrator, I want to add new issue types to an existing issue type scheme to accommodate new types of work.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the addition of the issue types to the specified issue type scheme.

gold.user: As a project manager, I need to reorder the issue types in an issue type scheme to prioritize certain types of issues.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the new order of issue types in the specified issue type scheme.

gold.user: As a Jira administrator, I want to remove an issue type from an issue type scheme that is no longer relevant to our projects.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the removal of the specified issue type from the issue type scheme.
